UI icons: Lucide https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/81875c8c42d2320fa5123b37fee3554f4ca2bddc/icons (ISC / Feather-derived MIT; see license).
Brand glyphs: Simple Icons https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons, YouTube, Twitch, Jellyfin (CC0; see license). SVGs bundled locally in icons.js.
LG pairing manifest: android-native/app/src/main/res/raw/lg_register.json is the registration payload from aiowebostv https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/aiowebostv (aiowebostv/handshake.py, Apache License 2.0), used by LumaX to pair with the LG TV directly.
